Image Description: The image depicts a section of an ornate building facade featuring a unique and artistic installation of decorative umbrellas and fans arranged in two clusters on the wall. The building has a pastel pink exterior with classical architectural elements, including white columns, window shutters, and decorative stone moldings. Two balconies with intricate wrought-iron railings flank the central artwork—one on the left and one on the right—each with detailed scrollwork and small decorative finials.
